description: This Java class 'AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' extends an abstract logging adapter to automatically discard MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries after each log operation. It serves as a wrapper around another 'AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' to add this behavior, primarily to manage diagnostic context cleanup after logs.

classes.name: AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending 'AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' that wraps another logging adapter to automatically discard MDC entries after each log method call.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of 'AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' with the provided logging adapter.
